parts: It comprised all that was required of the servant, from eight in the morning, exactly at which hour Phileas Fogg rose, till half-past eleven, when he left the house for the Reform Club – all the details of service, the tea and toast at twenty-three minutes past eight, the shaving-water at
, and the toilet at twenty minutes before ten.
title: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
